messages.subject: Spatial Menu
parts:
I can run Deducer, DeducerExtras, DeducerMMR, and DeducerPlugInExample. However, when I load DeducerSpatial, the spatial menu does not appear.

I am running these from 32 bit R v2.15, in Windows 7, without JGR.

No error messages appear at the command line.

Any suggestions on what to do here?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Spatial Menu
parts:
DeducerSpatial currently only supports the JGR console. Running from
the command line reduces what Deducer can do safely. The JGR console
is the recommended environment.

ian
